summary: The legal array length is capped at 100, too small for a stable scaling trend for two constant-work scans, so bounded work and property evidence replace runtime tiers.

replacement_checks.evidence: The accepted implementation inspects all N entries once to count zeroes and at most N suffix entries once more, for no more than 2N element inspections and constant auxiliary state.

Independent checks include exact shortest-swap distances for every binary array through length 10, every ternary array through length 11, 100,000 randomized legal arrays, and authored maximum-length boundary cases.
